item.title: Copper Prices Recover Following Recent Sell-Off
item.description: Copper prices saw a partial rebound after a significant decline on Wednesday. Market participants are questioning if the recent sell-off driven by AI and tariff concerns was excessive.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Raises Outlook Amid AI Demand
item.description: Palo Alto Networks increased its financial outlook following recent earnings results. Management cited the current threat landscape as a driver for future demand.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Acquires Applied Compute for $4.5 Billion
item.description: Palo Alto Networks announced a $4.5 billion acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute. Shares of the company rose 7% following the announcement and earnings report.

item.title: Nvidia Interim CEO Kress Addresses Staff Following Huang Departure
item.description: Interim CEO Colette Kress held her first all-hands meeting to encourage employees to move forward. The leadership transition follows the exit of former CEO Jensen Huang.

item.title: Death Cross Pattern Emerges in Small-Cap Stocks
item.description: A technical 'death cross' pattern has appeared in small-cap stocks. This indicator suggests potential weakness within the Russell 2000 index.

item.title: Oil Prices Stabilize Amid Geopolitical Tensions
item.description: Oil prices remained steady as market participants monitored the conflict between the US and Iran. Traders are evaluating the potential for further escalations involving Tehran.

item.title: Copper Supply Concerns May Impact AI Infrastructure
item.description: A recent decline in copper prices raises concerns about the long-term availability of the metal for AI infrastructure. Future mining output may struggle to keep pace with projected demand.

item.title: Anthropic May Increase IPO Offering Amid Strong Investor Interest
item.description: The AI company is reportedly considering a larger share offering due to high demand. Trading on the Nasdaq is scheduled to commence this Thursday.

item.title: Ed Yardeni Views Current Interest Rates as 'Normal for Longer'
item.description: Market researcher Ed Yardeni suggests that interest rates will remain at current levels rather than rising further. This perspective follows a period of inconsistent signals from central bank officials regarding the pace of future hikes.

item.title: Gopinath Notes Alignment Between Warsh and Waller on Fed Policy
item.description: Gita Gopinath suggests that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh shares a similar policy outlook to Governor Christopher Waller. Waller has explicitly advocated for a 50-basis-point rate hike in December.

item.title: Investors Pay Premium for Defensive Stocks Despite High Valuations
item.description: Market participants are favoring defensive sectors that have outperformed the S&P 500 recently. These stocks are trading at higher valuations relative to earnings estimates than the broader index.

item.title: Analyst Suggests Oracle Shares Remain Undervalued
item.description: Bernstein analysts argue that Oracle's stock price is low even under pessimistic business scenarios. The valuation remains attractive even if the company's AI data-center segment were to fail.

item.title: Nvidia Faces Uncertainty Despite Strong AI Demand
item.description: While demand for Nvidia products remains high, investors are concerned about several strategic risks. Key issues include leadership transition, export regulations, and market exposure to China.

item.title: Fed's Waller Suggests Potential Half-Point Rate Hike
item.description: Governor Waller indicated that the central bank might implement a 50-basis-point increase to address persistent inflation. Current price pressures remain above the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

item.title: Bitcoin Rally Fades Amid Liquidity Concerns and Exchange Hacks
item.description: Bitcoin has lost its recent gains as risk appetite wanes among investors. A major hack at Binance has contributed to thinner market liquidity and increased price volatility.

item.title: US Treasuries Gain for Third Session Amid Weakening Risk Appetite
item.description: Benchmark US government bonds rose for a third consecutive trading day as broader risk appetite weakened. Buying was also encouraged by expectations that the Federal Reserve's rate hikes may largely be priced into markets.

item.title: India-US Trade Agreement Nearly Complete, Says ITPO Chairman Ashraf
item.description: India Trade Promotion Organization Chairman Jawed Ashraf stated that the bilateral trade deal between India and the United States is roughly 99% finalized. He emphasized that India seeks to secure competitive advantages against competitors while guarding against unilateral US trade measures.

item.title: China's Xi Urges Fewer Trade Barriers Ahead of Trump and Putin Meetings
item.description: The Chinese leader spoke at the APEC summit in Shenzhen to advocate for reduced trade and investment obstacles. He also promised greater access to the nation's domestic market and manufacturing industry.

item.title: CoreWeave Stock Advances Despite Nvidia Signaling Cautious Customer Financing
item.description: CoreWeave shares gained even after Nvidia outlined plans to review its customer financing support carefully. Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress noted that while neocloud providers are growing in importance, financing will undergo thorough scrutiny.

item.title: Nvidia Rises on Strong Revenue Growth and $130 Billion Quarterly Forecast
item.description: Shares of the chipmaker rose following robust revenue expansion and a projected $130 billion quarter. The strong performance helped alleviate market concerns regarding its ongoing CEO transition.

item.title: Oil Prices Slip on Supply Recovery and Growing US Inventories
item.description: Crude prices fell slightly as investors focused on rising US stockpiles and indicators of rebounding output. Market participants largely shrugged off recent clashes in the Middle East.

item.title: Apollo CEO Sees Insurance Capital Financing $8 Trillion AI Expansion
item.description: Apollo Global Management CEO Marc Rowan stated that the artificial intelligence boom will require substantial long-term funding. He noted that capital from retirement and insurance assets could satisfy the sector's financing needs.

item.title: Costco Emergency Supply Sales Accelerate Following Tech and Flight Disruptions
item.description: Warehouse shoppers are stocking up on preparedness items amid broader fears spurred by recent infrastructure disruptions. Mizuho analysts observed higher emergency preparation demand following a Microsoft outage and nationwide grounded flights.

item.title: BofA Rates Team Highlights Possibility of Half-Point Fed Hike in December
item.description: Investors seeking 5% yields on short-term Treasurys are advised to monitor potential shifts in central bank policy. Bank of America Global's rates strategists indicated that a 50-basis-point interest-rate increase in December remains possible.

item.title: US Stock Futures Climb as Nvidia Revenue Guidance Beats Forecasts
item.description: Index contracts advanced after Nvidia released an upbeat sales outlook that exceeded Wall Street estimates. The result offered relief to equities after a previous deepening decline in semiconductor shares.

item.title: US Homebuilder Sentiment Drops to 14-Year Low Amid Rising Costs
item.description: Elevated mortgage rates alongside higher costs for labor, energy, and materials have pushed confidence among homebuilders down. In response to these conditions, an increasing share of builders is cutting home prices.

item.title: Anthropic Expected to Price IPO Above $70-$78 Target Range
item.description: The artificial intelligence startup is preparing to debut on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Sources indicate the offering price will likely exceed the previously projected $70 to $78 range.

item.title: Fed's Musalem suggests multiple rate hikes may be necessary
item.description: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem indicated that several interest rate increases could be required by spring. The goal of these potential hikes is to manage inflation.

item.title: Argentina energy sector to drive bond sales through 2027
item.description: A surge in dollar bond issuances by Argentine entities is expected to continue through the first half of 2027. This trend is supported by growth in the domestic energy industry.

item.title: Fund managers reduce exposure to technology stocks
item.description: Investors have cut their tech holdings at the fastest rate observed in two decades. There is a concurrent shift toward reducing bearish positions on bonds.
